fields.System.Title: API Gateway returning 503 for all /api/v2/reports endpoints — memory leak suspected
fields.System.Description:
The /api/v2/reports/* endpoints have been returning 503 Service Unavailable since 06:30 UTC. Memory usage on the API Gateway pods has been climbing steadily and pods are OOM-killed every ~20 minutes.

Impact: All report generation features (CSV export, scheduled reports, analytics dashboard) are unavailable in production.

Evidence:
- Pod memory: 1.8GB → 2.1GB over 30 min (limit: 2GB)
- OOM Kill events in k8s: 4 in last 2 hours
- No matching errors in the code changes from last deploy

Possible cause: The new streaming response handler introduced in PR #987 may have a memory leak when processing large datasets.
fields.System.Tags: production; memory-leak; oom; reports; p1; regression
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.TCM.ReproSteps:
1. Call GET /api/v2/reports/export?format=csv&date_range=30d with a large dataset
  2. Observe API response: 503 after ~45s
  3. Monitor pod memory: continuous climb, no release
